shiton.name: Ситон
shiton.subtitle: Стихия смерти/разложения
shiton.chakra_approach: Суйтон (вода/влага биологических тканей), Дотон (минеральное тело, почва/кость), Интон (духовные и посмертные остаточные структуры) used synergistically through old forbidden fūinjutsu Latest direct player canon: chakra schools are practical human-compatible delivery channels for Utsuro's actual DEMONIC DEATH essence, not exhaustive ontological explanation.
shiton.category: Intrinsic real supernatural DEMONIC Death Release (死遁), expressed through bounded ninjutsu/fuinjutsu and Suiton/Doton/Yin chakra interfaces. NOT ordinary combined human elements or automatically genetically heritable Kekkei Tōta; demonic power truly exists independently of a chakra-technical recipe.
shiton.art_identity: Dead matter, corpse-animation, necrosis, death-echo, funerary sealing and active decay; it does NOT freely return original souls or ignore material conservation.
shiton.nightmare: The last human form persists after the person ends; what comes back may imitate but is not them.

byoton.name: Бётон
byoton.subtitle: Стихия болезни
byoton.chakra_approach: Суйтон water environment/biological fluids + Ётон (陽遁) life-process stimulus/control, with Inton to impose pathological chakra templates or prior pattern Latest direct player canon: these are only chakra/medical means by which a REAL DEMON OF MEDICINE/DEATH/DISEASE manifests its inhuman power, not sufficient origin.
byoton.category: Intrinsic real supernatural DEMONIC Disease Release (病遁), expressed through medical Yin/Yang and Suiton chakra interfaces, not inherently genetic or ordinary biomedical infection. DEMONIC illness principles real, bounded effects and countermeasures.
byoton.art_identity: Inversion of medical chakra: disordered inflammation, fever, pain and pathological tissue growth, abnormal repair, disease seals, anti-healing traps. No instantaneous species-scale autonomous epidemic.
byoton.nightmare: Life continues to grow where it should stop, and the healing hand may make it worse.

design_constraints: Ranks are approximate practical relative danger, not reliable cast speed. B can kill a helpless person; S can fail against prepared specialist. Full cost depends on amount of target matter, exposure, anchored chakra, terrain and time.

Effects like fast tissue growth are chakra-forced supernatural events, NOT ordinary viruses/fungi/cancers instantly growing or blood literally boiling at 42°C. Mark real observable signs vs magical interpretation.

Чакровые болезни имеют сверхъестественную природу. Особый поздний прямой канон игрока: активная техника Byōton «Плачущие Бубоны» способна передать гной с едким и заражающим действием на другую цель при фактическом попадании; не подменять это пассивным касанием Шики и не вводить фиксированный радиус или произвольную всеобщую эпидемию.

Shiton can use previously dead tissue, corpse seals or living tissue necrosis but never freely create matter or resurrect an intact person. Stored residual chakra is not the entire deceased person's mind.

Byōton targets LIVING physiology, may be countered by elite medical ninjutsu, elemental dispersion, seal removal and chakra resistance; effects have onset windows and require proximity/contact, path or preconditions.

Both schools are possessed by male Utsuro, but precise ownership/mastery of individual techniques should be revealed/verified in narrative, not assumed by player-character Shiki. Pact does NOT grant any technique formula automatically.

Latest player correction 2026-11-14: permanent gauntness/altered appearance and ONLY direct bare skin-to-skin passive illness effect. Intact gloves, cloth and objects absolutely prevent contact transfer. Warm skin, fever, taste/pain alterations remain excluded. Unusual smells NOW explicitly allowed by latest player 2026-11-15, only progressive at stage1+ and non-contagious. PC agency unaffected.

Shiki's elite med chakra 5/5, chakra control 5/5, and Zero Genome biological self-regulation are genuine advantages to learning or resisting physical effects; cannot by themselves break irrevocable external summons contract.
Utsuro has finite chakra and physical embodiment; high-rank attacks use field preparation, seals, scarce resources or sustained attention. No continent/city-scale gods or free resurrection.

repertoire.title: Кашель Гниющего Лотоса
repertoire.premise: Пользователь выдыхает облако невидимых спор из некротической демонической чакры Ситона. При вдыхании они оседают в лёгких цели и повреждают живую ткань изнутри; сильное воздействие приводит к мучительному кашлю с чёрными гниющими лепестками из отмерших тканей лёгких, удушью и возможной смерти.
repertoire.horror: Жертва откашливает чёрные лепестки своей собственной гниющей лёгочной ткани.
repertoire.conditions: Требуется фактическое вдыхание облака и достаточная экспозиция; возможны защита дыхания, уклонение, рассеивание и медицинское противодействие. Не объявлять мгновенную гарантированную смерть. Споры — сверхъестественная чакровая сущность, не обычный созданный микроб.
repertoire.counterplay: Airflow / sealing screen / withdrawal / advanced medical suppression; without field anchoring remnants rapidly inert; severe outcomes need sustained effect.

repertoire.title: Шёпот срезанных лиц
repertoire.japanese: 死遁・切り取られた顔の囁き
repertoire.premise: Across an existing surface, distorted clay or corpse-mask forms repeat fragmented chakra impressions extracted from local death traces, amplified by Yin sensory interference.
repertoire.horror: A face without a tongue recites the last unfinished syllable someone said when dying; some masks are indistinguishable from people still alive.
repertoire.conditions: Needs residual trace/place/corpse sample and local fūin anchor; cannot summon true memories of everyone dead within a kilometer. Multiple masks increase chakra and concentration cost.
repertoire.counterplay: Break shadow/trace anchor, genjutsu Kai, hearing protection may reduce sound but not all chakra-based sensory effects, sensory specialist can distinguish false residual echoes.

repertoire.title: Искусство мясника: Вывернутая боль
repertoire.japanese: 死遁・肉屋の術・反転痛覚
repertoire.romaji: Shiton: Nikuya no Jutsu — Hanten Tsūkaku
repertoire.premise: Precision chakra intrusion at tenketsu or peripheral nerve field drastically raises sensory gain and corrupts body location signals: fabric becomes intolerable and ordinary pulse feels like impacts; leaves target technically conscious.
repertoire.horror: The victim feels fingers brushing bone inside still-undamaged skin and hears their own heartbeat as cracking joints.
repertoire.conditions: Requires close precise contact and coherent neural target pathways; cannot invert every nervous system by mere gaze. Loss of focus or damage to delivery reduces effect.
repertoire.counterplay: Chakra interruption/Kai in susceptible sensory component, advanced medical modulation or targeted nerve protection; immobilization not guaranteed, skilled fighter may fight through pain.

repertoire.title: Ассимиляция мёртвой плоти
repertoire.premise: Transforms nearby dead organic material into an attached temporary armor, tendon-like false limb, or additional grasping structure under corpse-binding chakra.
repertoire.horror: Borrowed fingers keep the last curvature of their prior owner's hands; an attached palm may preserve old calluses and scars.
repertoire.conditions: Requires available corpse biomass and active fūin control, consumes material and chakra; immediate apparent limb is a controlled prosthetic, not instant fully integrated living limb. Real persistent transplant needs medical reconstruction.
repertoire.counterplay: Separate chakra anchor / physical disruption of corpse-prosthesis / fire and purification, reject unstable graft if left unsupported; possible medical/genetic compatibility affects long-term integration.

repertoire.title: Кровавая химера: Танец сращённых
repertoire.japanese: 死遁・血肉鬼合・融合の舞
repertoire.romaji: Shiton: Ketsuniku Kigō — Yūgō no Mai
repertoire.premise: An anchored taboo fūin mass coerces multiple living or recently dead bodies into one short-lived grotesque joint fighting assembly; where living subjects remain conscious this is an agonizing violation, not a harmless summon.
repertoire.horror: Multiple mouths continue arguing about whose lungs are breathing, even though there is only one ribcage left capable of moving.
repertoire.conditions: Requires multiple captured bodies, substantial matter, structured sealing field and prolonged chakra feeding; can fail or kill victims during assembly; not instantly creates an invincible boss from any random enemies.
repertoire.counterplay: Disrupt preparation, release victims, sever ritual anchor and medical rescue where viable; the construct is mortal, finite and unstable, without infinite capacity.

repertoire.title: Озеро чёрного ихора
repertoire.premise: High-output localized terrain corruption: soil, preexisting moisture and sacrificial corpse matter collapse into dark viscous necrotic chakra mire with gripping appendage-like flows and genuine lethal tissue destruction on prolonged contact.
repertoire.horror: Hands rise from a surface that has never held a burial, and the mud repeats the shape of every person it has swallowed.
repertoire.conditions: Requires terrain mass/water and large chakra output plus an anchor; practical field tens of meters at extraordinary cost, not a kilometre-scale domain or literally perpetual conscious decomposition.
repertoire.counterplay: Raised footing, intense elemental disruption, high mobility and anchor destruction; overextension can expose caster, material cannot persist eternally without support.

repertoire.title: Гробница собственного тела
repertoire.premise: A precise blood/seal-linked curse disrupts skeletal tissue architecture and directs violent inward abnormal bone remodeling. Successful full progression threatens catastrophic internal compression.
repertoire.horror: The prison walls are the victim's own ribs; escape becomes harder with each breath.
repertoire.conditions: Requires a verified blood/chakra link or bodily anchored seal; visual contact alone is insufficient; progression is perceptible and can be interrupted. Not infinite bone growth from no calcium or chakra.
repertoire.counterplay: Break blood anchor/mark, barrier interference, rapid high-grade medical chakra and skeletal support, caster incapacitation; still extremely dangerous even to high-level shinobi when prepared.

repertoire.title: Дыхание Красной смерти
repertoire.premise: Visible pale-red chakra haze produces an acute unnatural fever-like pathological syndrome within a limited exposed area: heat, delirium, vascular symptoms and loss of coordination in sufficiently affected targets.
repertoire.horror: Victims see red stains along light and hear voices feverishly whisper their names, although no actual voices are near them.
repertoire.conditions: Requires close controlled chakra cloud contact/exposure and target's living biological pathways; no blood boiling at 42°C, no rapid viral reproduction and no instant universal fatality.
repertoire.counterplay: Move to clean air/clear field via wind/water, barrier or chakra interference and medical response, exposure time/defensive ability matter.

repertoire.title: Плачущие Бубоны
repertoire.premise: Чакровая ловушка «Плачущие Бубоны» накладывается при контакте в тайдзюцу или посредством сенбона, доставившего чакру Бётона. В точке поражения на теле врага быстро набухают большие пульсирующие чёрные гнойники, причиняя мучительную пульсирующую боль. Когда нарывы самопроизвольно разрываются или их вскрывают, под давлением выбрасывается едкий заразный гной. Если этот гной попадает на другого человека, он вызывает ожог и заражение. Фиксированного радиуса поражения нет; последствия определяются фактическим попаданием выделений.
repertoire.horror: Огромные чёрные пульсирующие гнойники разрываются с выбросом едкого заразного содержимого; попавшие на других брызги причиняют ожоги и заражение.
repertoire.conditions: Первичная чакровая ловушка ставится ударом или прямым контактом тайдзюцу, либо заряженным Бётоном сенбоном. При разрыве нарыва вторичное поражение определяется тем, попал ли гной на окружающих: если да, возникают ожог и заражение. Фиксированной дистанции нет, автоматической волны заражения нет.
repertoire.counterplay: Защита от контакта и сенбонов, противодействие чакровой ловушке, уклонение от фактического выброса, защита кожи, удаление чакрового паттерна, медицинская помощь. Отдельно от пассивного касания по договору.

repertoire.title: Проклятие кордицепса: Повинующийся труп
repertoire.japanese: 病遁・冬虫菌糸・従う屍
repertoire.premise: A forbidden parasite-shaped chakra pattern winds through a target's peripheral motor command pathways under anchored seal, progressively steals muscular obedience while preserving awareness.
repertoire.horror: A shinobi keeps trying to signal with his fingers while those same fingers calmly untie his own weapons.
repertoire.conditions: Must deliver marked chakra to wound/contact and establish stable network; not literal mushroom fungi penetrating entire brain in seconds; control is contested by chakra defense and sensory disruption.
repertoire.counterplay: Medical/chakra diagnosis, fūin removal, sever or disrupt source and counter-regulation; cannot instantly remotely possess any healthy organism.

repertoire.title: Злокачественное цветение
repertoire.premise: Pathological Yang chakra induces violent localized disordered growth and tissue-repair errors—abnormal masses, mislaid calcification and deformation—which can cripple limbs or organs if allowed to progress.
repertoire.horror: Bone blossoms just beneath intact skin, bending the joints into the posture of someone already laid out for burial.
repertoire.conditions: Pathological growth is externally forced by chakra and energetic expenditure, not ordinary malignant cancer progressing millions of times faster; requires contact/anchor and meaningful development time.
repertoire.counterplay: Medical chakra counter-regulation, interrupt seal/source, targeted removal or regeneration; extreme tissue damage may require restoration and reserves.

repertoire.title: Идеальный паразит: Белая чума
repertoire.premise: A malicious fūin-imprinted tissue affliction responds to otherwise beneficial healing chakra by twisting local regenerative signals into painful pathological overgrowth or necrotic misrepair, endangering a patient and healer within connected active chakra path.
repertoire.horror: Every healing pulse seems to close a wound—then the scar opens again, deeper, as if the body is remembering the wrong injury.
repertoire.conditions: Not an engineered self-replicating virus; the pattern must already be on a target and stays bounded to marked tissue/actual linked chakra exchange. Strong healing can become counterproductive until the seal is diagnosed.
repertoire.counterplay: Identify malignant pattern and isolate/disrupt curse prior to further healing, barriers and separate medical counter-jutsu; experienced medics can win. No automatic contagious dissolution of entire squads.

repertoire.title: Владения Больного Бога
repertoire.premise: Large prepared restricted illness field affects living vegetation and organisms with multiple simultaneous disease-curse expressions: blighted wood, severe fever, abnormal flesh repair, frailty and sensory delirium, growing worse with time and exposure.
repertoire.horror: Trees seem to acquire bruises on their bark; cloth against the skin feels like the touch of an examiner testing whether the body is already dead.
repertoire.conditions: True prepared zone constrained by material anchors, time and staggering chakra expenditure; local building/block scale rather than 1km auto-death. This is a title/folk epithet not proof that Utsuro is a god.
repertoire.counterplay: Evacuate, destroy anchors, sealing barriers and specialist medical treatment; even high-level user risks backlash and cannot safely deploy around allies casually.
